hook_text: My phone is hibernating till spring

song.title: Hibernate
song.style: English, cozy country waltz, warm acoustic guitar, pedal steel, gentle fiddle, soft female lead vocal, 3/4 time, 90 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tucked my phone up on the fridge
Like a bear inside a den
Little brick of mossy green
Wake it up when spring comes in

[Chorus]
Hibernate, hibernate
All the pings can wait
Snow outside and soup inside
Hibernate tonight

shots.prompt: A fuzzy bear yawns hugely and curls up to sleep inside a cozy cave, snowflakes drifting past the entrance. Static medium shot. Soft blue winter light and a warm amber glow inside.
A woman in a knitted hat stirs a big pot of soup on a stove, steam curling up, then sniffs and smiles. The camera pushes in gently. Warm kitchen glow, orange and cream.
Two children build a lumpy snowman in a garden, one placing a carrot nose, then both jump with joy. Static wide shot. Bright white snow, soft blue sky.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
Two friends sit by a crackling fireplace playing a board game, one throwing up his arms in triumph. Static medium shot. Flickering orange firelight.
A man reads a thick book in an armchair with a sleeping cat on his lap, snow falling past the window behind him. The camera slowly drifts closer. Warm lamp light, deep greens and amber.
A girl ice skates in a slow wobbly circle on a frozen pond, arms out wide, giggling. The camera circles slowly around her. Pale winter sun, soft blues.
Two neighbours pass a steaming pie over a snowy fence, both grinning. Static side view. Golden afternoon light on snow.
A bear sleeps peacefully curled in its cave as the snow outside melts and a single green sprout pops up at the entrance in spring sunlight. Slow push in. Soft green and warm gold.

caption: My phone went into hibernation in its Hibernator. See you in spring, little guy.
